Photo shows a plume of smile rising from the center of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, following a missile attack from Yemen.

The Houthis announced to have targeted the Saudi Ministry of Defense Headquarters, however, it is still unknown what was hit.

q.text:

1) Saudi Ministry of Defense Headquarters, Riyadh

2) Dammam Airport

3) Aramco facilities in Yanbu

4) Abha Airport
